candidates.final_prompt: Use case: lighting-weather edit. Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 is the approved set-wide grade anchor. Image 3 supplies the lighter website-blue family. Image 4 governs restrained Mitch-style directional light and natural editing. Image 5 governs dry carob morphology only. Harmonize only the colour grade, exposure, shadow density and fine matte grain of Image 1. Preserve its exact 1672x941 canvas, shallow camera, dish, pod, object geometry, scale, positions, crop, negative space and lower 40% safe field. Bring the empty lower blue field toward a pale powder blue around #C2D7E8, with muted saturation, clean highlights, medium-low contrast and no vignette. Preserve one soft upper-left afternoon shadow. Keep the pod dry dark natural brown, the dish desaturated grey-blue and all surfaces matte. Do not add, remove, reshape or reposition anything. No text, packaging, people, foliage, watermark or border.
